body: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. has asked the court to grant summary judgment in its foreclosure on Rochester Tech Park, the Rochester Business Journal reported on October 22, 2026. The lender, which provided just over $110 million in loans on the property in 2017, alleges that Tech Park Owner LLC and its two mortgage guarantors defaulted and owe $96.9 million in principal plus mounting interest and fees.

The motion also details two emergency payments totaling $2.356 million that Wells Fargo made to Rochester Gas & Electric in 2024: the first cured a delinquency that had led to a power shutoff, and the second prevented further shutoffs, according to the RBJ. The loans are secured by the 288-acre, 4-million-square-foot office, industrial and manufacturing property along Elmgrove Road in Gates, according to documents filed in state Supreme Court in Monroe County.

Wells Fargo filed the foreclosure complaint in April 2025. A Dallas-based receiver has overseen daily operations for more than a year, and its latest report lists close to two dozen tenants, including Harris Corp., Kodak Alaris, Monroe 2 BOCES and the University of Rochester. Justice Daniel J. Doyle is scheduled to hear arguments on the motion on January 12, 2027. The RBJ report did not include a response from the owner.
